applies_why: The judge text assesses whether the Acts 2:30 loins/seed row was answered or pressed, which is the witness-counting subject K-G4 governs.
quote: [CR2] and [CR3] answered the loins/seed row with Genesis 46:26 and Hebrews 7:10 (loins at depth) and the legal/flesh distinction, while [DR3] presses that the only named Davidic man is Joseph; neither chain forces the other.
rule_words: If the judge says a verse was answered, the judge must not count it. Not counting it obeys this rule.
room: counts toward a broken link: I weighed whether UNDERDETERMINED still treats the pressed verse as a broken-link witness, versus not counting it because the row was answered and neither chain forces the other; I read it as the latter.
why: The judge says the row was answered and labels the point UNDERDETERMINED, so it does not count Acts 2:30 as an unanswered witness toward a broken link.
